builder_admin_set.meaning: builderAdmin storage slot of BuilderWallet is already set to a non-zero admin

init_called_by_factory.meaning: BuilderFactory.deployBuilder() deployed the BuilderWallet and called init(legitimateAdmin)

wallet_fee_balance.meaning: tokens accumulated in the BuilderWallet from builder fees

reinit_attempted.meaning: a second call to BuilderWallet.init() is made after builderAdmin is already set

funds_stolen.meaning: direct theft of funds from the BuilderWallet occurs

assumptions: builderAdmin is set to legitimateAdmin by the factory's init call at deployment.
The re-initialization attempt targets the same BuilderWallet holding accumulated fees.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether the attacker's init overwrites an existing admin or whether init was already called before the attacker's call; the guard relation is modeled as forbidding re-init when builderAdmin is set.

limitations: The exact access-control guard (onlyFactory vs constructor-set admin) is not specified; the plan encodes the report-stated requirement that re-initialization is forbidden once builderAdmin is set.
No concrete numeric balance is established; wallet_fee_balance is symbolic and only constrained to be positive.
